package.name: mower_alerts
package.description: Theft / geofence, lift / tilt and mission incident alerts (stuck, path blocked, mowing incomplete, docking failed, emergency stop, RTK lost, battery critical) with debounce, per-incident dedupe and rate limiting. Publishes /mower_alerts/events (JSON), which the MowgliNext GUI backend delivers over the operator's notification channel and MQTT.
